description: Kagura Memory tool guardrails. Changing any matcher or handler below changes that hook's trust hash and Codex skips it until each user trusts it again in /hooks; the repo pins this file's SHA-256 so no change is accidental.

hooks.command: p=$(command -v python3) || exit 0; case "$p" in /*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; case "$p" in "$PWD"/*) exit 0;; esac; exec "$p" -I -S "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/kagura_guardrails.py" --client codex
